elsewhere:galvanic_upgrade_smithing_temp: How to get: Galvanox drops it (50%). Copy it with 7 Pearlite and a copper block.
elsewhere:ironclad_chain: How to get: Thurgrim drops it (50%). Smith it onto a diamond sword with Skyiron: Ironclad Flail.
elsewhere:steam_auger_bit: How to get: Thurgrim drops it (50%). Smith it onto a diamond pickaxe with Skyiron: Steam Auger.
elsewhere:heliodor_mirror_core: How to get: Heliodor drops it (50%). Crafts the Mirrorbolt Arbalest.
elsewhere:termite_queen: How to get: Mother Creak drops it (50%). Crafts the Termite Hive Lantern with Amber and a lantern.
elsewhere:amberstill_upgrade_smithing_te: How to get: Mother Creak drops it (50%). Copy it with 7 diamonds and Pale Bark.
elsewhere:gale_rapier: How to get: Tempestra drops it (30%), or trade with the Windwright (Zephyr Feathers and Zephyrite).
elsewhere:seers_hourglass: Trinket: works from your off hand or hotbar (2 trinkets active at most). Boss attack hints appear for you and boss warnings come 0.15 s earlier.
How to get: Selenne drops it (35%).
elsewhere:prospectors_pendulum: Trinket: swings toward the nearest ore within 24 blocks; use it in hand to name up to 2 ore types and their distance. Never finds diamond or ancient debris.
How to get: Ironpeak chests (Climber's Cairn, Clan Hold, 12%), Thurgrim (20%), or a Skyiron trade.
elsewhere:void_tether_spool: Sneak + use sets an anchor; use snaps you back within 64 blocks (same dimension, 3-minute cooldown, 4 hunger points).
How to get: Aphelion drops it (35%), Ossyra (10%).
elsewhere:termite_hive_lantern: Mine a block and termites eat the 3x3 face around it over 2 s. Dirt, wood, mud and stone only.
How to get: craft it (Termite Queen, Amber, lantern) or trade Haze Resin in the Greenhaze.
